dialogues.speaker: Kayvan
dialogues.text: Life by the sea is relaxing, but there are still occasional dangers that should be treated with caution.

dialogues.speaker: Kayvan
dialogues.text: The shores of Sumeru are fraught with sea monster attacks, which often affect residents and fishermen who live along the coast and disrupt the merchant ships.

dialogues.speaker: Kayvan
dialogues.text: Fortunately, we're all familiar with the situation at sea and know how to protect ourselves. Plus, with the Eremites' assistance, there haven't been any major casualties.

dialogues.speaker: Kayvan
dialogues.text: The Akademiya's researchers have gradually come here, too, to investigate the pattern of the sea monster attacks, thus improving the effectiveness of our defense.

dialogues.speaker: Kayvan
dialogues.text: But just because the situation has improved, doesn't mean we can let our guard down. We must always watch out when near the sea and follow the instructions in case of an emergency.
